title: Goat OS — Mobile (goatos-android)
description: Android telemetry from actual app_events daily cohort rollups and Crashlytics. Missing data is a collection/rollup gap, never synthesized success. Network timing collection is independently identified in its panel.

panels.title: Android exported network requests — daily p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: App-wide daily approximate percentiles of completed NETWORK_REQUEST samples exported by Firebase Performance, split by app version, route, method and response class. These are exported samples, not every attempted network operation. No export/rollup rows means unavailable; daily percentiles are not combined into a window percentile. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate. Initial Firebase delivery: these exports were requested in Firebase; enabled transfer configuration is verified separately. No source tables existed at request time. An empty panel means samples are unavailable, never zero requests or zero crashes; disabled or failed transfers are configuration failures, not initial delivery delays. Deployment may report a separately bounded initial-export pending state; after its deadline or once any source table arrives, missing data is a failure requiring schema configuration and backfill. Initial-export wait deadline: 2026-09-18T09:09:59.642000+00:00. A later empty panel is not an approved provider wait.

defaults.noValue: No exported samples — see panel info

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, metric, p50, p95, p99 FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, concat(app_version, ' · ', http_method, ' ', route_pattern, ' · ', response_class) AS metric, p50_ms AS p50, p95_ms AS p95, p99_ms AS p99 FROM analytics.app_network_daily WHERE source_app_id = 'sg.mesha.goatos' AND total_requests > 0) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Analytics-rollup job run duration by outcome
panels.description: kernel.analytics_rollup.run.duration (Cloud Run Job, GA4/Crashlytics BigQuery aggregation + Postgres upsert), label outcome (succeeded/failed/skipped). 'skipped' is the expected exit-0 path today, since GOATOS_GA4_EXPORT_DATASET is unset in stg until the Firebase GA4 BigQuery export is manually linked (infra/envs/stg/analytics_rollup.tf).
panels.goatosMissingCapability: kernel_analytics_rollup_run_duration_seconds is not emitted in STG yet

panels.title: Analytics summary rows replaced per run
panels.description: Rows atomically replaced in daily summary tables by a rollup run. This is write volume, not new event count: rerunning the same day replaces rows again. No metric means the job has not exported an observed run.
panels.goatosMissingCapability: kernel_analytics_rollup_rows_written_total is not emitted in STG yet

panels.title: Observed Android journeys and ordered funnels
Completed proof / camera / bootstrap journeys — daily p50 / p90 / p99
panels.description: Daily completed-cohort percentiles from actual Android app_events. Proof: capture→upload completed; camera: requested→finalized; login: success→bootstrap loaded. Missing stages do not count as completion. Daily percentiles are not aggregated into a window percentile. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, metric, p50, p90, p99 FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, journey_key AS metric, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p50_ms/1000.0 END AS p50, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p90_ms/1000.0 END AS p90, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p99_ms/1000.0 END AS p99 FROM analytics.journey_daily WHERE tenant_id = ${tenant:sqlstring}::uuid AND journey_key IN ('proof_delivery','camera_capture','login_to_bootstrap')) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: App-wide observed crash-free sessions — daily by app version
panels.description: Firebase same-business-day observed SESSION_START cohort with collection enabled and matched fatal events; app-wide, not tenant scoped or lifetime session crash ratio. Requires both Crashlytics and Firebase Sessions exports; no rows means unavailable, never 100% crash-free. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate. Initial Firebase delivery: these exports were requested in Firebase; enabled transfer configuration is verified separately. No source tables existed at request time. An empty panel means samples are unavailable, never zero requests or zero crashes; disabled or failed transfers are configuration failures, not initial delivery delays. Deployment may report a separately bounded initial-export pending state; after its deadline or once any source table arrives, missing data is a failure requiring schema configuration and backfill. Initial-export wait deadline: 2026-09-18T09:08:30.643000+00:00. A later empty panel is not an approved provider wait.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, metric, crash_free_sessions_pct FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, app_version AS metric, crash_free_sessions_pct FROM analytics.app_crash_daily WHERE source_app_id = 'sg.mesha.goatos' AND total_sessions > 0) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

defaults.noValue: No exported samples — see panel info

panels.title: Ordered proof / camera / feed funnel cohorts
panels.description: Ordered per-day cohort reach. Feed synced requires observed server acknowledgment, not local enqueue. Work sessions are authenticated actor/device/journey tuples; they are not GA4 sessions. Do not sum distinct users across days. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_date, funnel_key, step_index, step_key, reached_cohorts, distinct_users, work_sessions FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, event_date, funnel_key, step_index, step_key, conversions AS reached_cohorts, users AS distinct_users, sessions AS work_sessions FROM analytics.funnel_daily WHERE tenant_id = ${tenant:sqlstring}::uuid) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY event_date, funnel_key, step_index

panels.title: Feed journeys — feature open to server acknowledgment
panels.description: Daily completed-cohort p50/p90/p99. Duration starts at observed feature open and ends at matching server acknowledgment. Local enqueue is an intermediate step, not success. Missing completions show no latency value. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, metric, p50, p90, p99 FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, journey_key AS metric, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p50_ms/1000.0 END AS p50, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p90_ms/1000.0 END AS p90, CASE WHEN completions > 0 THEN p99_ms/1000.0 END AS p99 FROM analytics.journey_daily WHERE tenant_id = ${tenant:sqlstring}::uuid AND journey_key IN ('feed_distribution','feed_packing','feed_wastage','feed_transport')) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Observed Android users and work sessions — daily
panels.description: Distinct authenticated actors and actor/device/journey work sessions observed in app_events. Weekly users are the rollup seven-day distinct-actor count, not a sum of daily users. Event coverage gaps can undercount activity. Daily buckets are placed at their Asia/Kolkata business-day end; the selected window chooses completed day ends, not a rolling-window aggregate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, daily_users, seven_day_users, work_sessions FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, dau AS daily_users, wau_approx AS seven_day_users, sessions AS work_sessions FROM analytics.engagement_daily WHERE tenant_id = ${tenant:sqlstring}::uuid) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_date, app_version, route_pattern, http_method, response_class, total_requests FROM (SELECT ((event_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') - interval '1 second' AS time, event_date, app_version, route_pattern, http_method, response_class, total_requests FROM analytics.app_network_daily WHERE source_app_id = 'sg.mesha.goatos' AND total_requests > 0) q WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY event_date, route_pattern, http_method, response_class

panels.title: Rollup last successful completion — hours ago
panels.description: Global rollup-job audit, independent of dashboard time filter. More than 30 hours since last successful completion is stale for the daily 03:15 IST schedule. No successful history is Never completed, not zero hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-r.finished_at)/3600.0)::double precision AS age_hours FROM (SELECT 1) anchor LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT finished_at FROM analytics.rollup_run WHERE status='succeeded' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true

panels.title: Latest rollup run — status and source date
panels.description: Actual last job result, not Scheduler HTTP delivery status. A running, skipped, or failed run does not refresh the successful-completion age. Source date is the last business day covered by that invocation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.status,'Never run') AS status, r.source_date, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.rows_written, r.error FROM (SELECT 1) anchor LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status,source_date,started_at,finished_at,rows_written,error FROM analytics.rollup_run ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
